'''Urlos Du'Ram''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] of the [[Death's Claw]] pirate gang who resided on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-affiliated individual.

==Behind the scenes==
Urlos Du'Ram appears in the [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an Elite boss on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Taris. He is not directly involved in any quests, however he can be killed by any Republic-affiliated character as part of the achievement "Liberator of Taris". This articles assumes 100% game completion, which means Du'Ram was killed.
